title: Gruha Lakshmi Karnataka 2026 - ₹2,000 Monthly Status Check
meta_description: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi 2026: Get ₹2,000 monthly. Check status at ahara.kar.nic.in. Eligibility, RC number, biometric, apply online. 1.28 crore beneficiaries.

hero.one_liner: ₹2,000 monthly direct cash transfer to women heads of household in Karnataka

what_is_it: The Gruha Lakshmi Scheme is a flagship welfare program by the Karnataka government that puts cash directly into the hands of women. If you're the head of your household - whether you're single, separated, widowed, or your family depends on you - this scheme gives you ₹2,000 every month.
That's ₹24,000 per year, transferred straight to your bank account.

The scheme targets women from Antyodaya (poorest), BPL (below poverty line), and APL (above poverty line) ration card households. It doesn't matter if you work as a laborer, farmer, or stay home managing the household.
The only condition is that you're identified as the head of your family and meet the income criteria. Currently, 1.28 crore women across Karnataka receive this benefit.

The money comes via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), meaning there's no middleman, no delays at offices, and no chance of corruption. The amount goes directly from the government into your bank account every month.
You don't have to visit any office repeatedly to get paid. Since it started, the scheme has distributed over ₹28,800 crore to struggling households.

This scheme recognizes that women often bear the weight of household management and decision-making, especially in poor families. Whether you're buying groceries, paying school fees, or managing medical emergencies, this ₹2,000 is yours to use as you see fit.
It's designed to give you financial independence and reduce reliance on others in the family.

extra_sections.heading: Latest Payment Updates
content: As of March 2026, the 27th installment of ₹2,000 was released on March 9, 2026. Payments are typically released once every month, though the exact dates vary based on government budget cycles and administrative processes.
Payment usually arrives in your account within 3-7 days of the release date shown in the DBT app. If you're enrolled and your Aadhaar-linked bank account is active, the money will come automatically.
There's no need to visit any office or ask for payment.
The scheme has distributed over ₹28,800 crore since its launch. Payments are made through Direct Benefit Transfer, which means they're transparent, trackable, and can't be intercepted or lost.

extra_sections.title: Monthly DBT to women head of household in Karnataka
extra_sections.desc: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi transfers ₹2,000 monthly directly to Aadhaar-linked bank account of woman head of household. Total ₹24,000 per year tax-free.

extra_sections.title: Who qualifies as 'head of household'?
extra_sections.content:
The woman must be the head of the family as per the ration card. Only one woman per household can receive the benefit.

The applicant must hold a BPL or Antyodaya ration card in Karnataka. Government employees, income tax payers, and families owning more than a specified land area are excluded.

extra_sections.heading: How Gruha Lakshmi Works - Monthly Transfer Explained
content: Karnataka's Gruha Lakshmi scheme provides Rs 2,000 per month to the woman head of every eligible household in the state. The transfer is made directly to the woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account, ensuring the money reaches the intended beneficiary without intermediaries.

The annual benefit of Rs 24,000 makes Gruha Lakshmi the most generous among India's monthly women's cash transfer schemes - higher than Maharashtra's Majhi Ladki Bahin (Rs 1,500/month) and Madhya Pradesh's Ladli Behna (Rs 1,250/month). The scheme specifically targets the woman identified as the head of household in the ration card, creating a clear and verifiable eligibility criterion.
The monthly payment is typically credited around the same date each month. Beneficiaries receive SMS notifications when the payment is processed.
The regularity of transfers allows women to plan their monthly budget around this predictable income stream, using it for groceries, children's education, healthcare, or savings.

extra_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria and Who Qualifies
content: Gruha Lakshmi targets the woman head of household as identified on the BPL or Antyodaya Anna Yojana ration card. The applicant must be a Karnataka resident with a valid ration card in her name.
She must be at least 18 years of age. No upper age limit applies, making the scheme accessible to elderly women heading households.
Women who are currently employed by the central government, state government, or any public sector undertaking are not eligible. Women whose family members are income tax payers are excluded.
Women already receiving pension benefits exceeding a specified threshold from any government scheme are not eligible to avoid benefit duplication.

The scheme does not require the woman to be married - unmarried, widowed, divorced, and separated women who are listed as the head of household on their ration card are all eligible. This inclusive criteria ensures that single women heading households, who are often among the most economically vulnerable, receive the benefit.

extra_sections.title: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi vs Telangana Gruha Lakshmi - Different Schemes
extra_sections.content:
Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi gives ₹2,000/month via Sevasindhu portal. Telangana Gruha Lakshmi was a BRS-era housing scheme now replaced by Indiramma Indlu.

This page covers ONLY the Karnataka cash transfer scheme.

extra_sections.heading: Application Process - Online and Offline
content: Official Application Portal (Karnataka): The primary online portal for Gruha Lakshmi is ahara.kar.nic.in (the Karnataka Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs portal, which manages ration card and beneficiary databases). Alternatively, use the Seva Sindhu portal at sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in.
Both portals are official. Applications can also be submitted at Karnataka One centers, nearest Gram Panchayat offices (rural), or Ward offices (urban).
The scheme registration camps were also held at taluk-level offices across Karnataka.

Registration for Gruha Lakshmi can be done through the Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in), at Karnataka One centers, or through designated registration camps organized at the Gram Panchayat level in rural areas and ward offices in urban areas.
For online registration, visit the Seva Sindhu portal and navigate to the Gruha Lakshmi section. Enter your ration card number and Aadhaar number.
Verify through OTP sent to your registered mobile number. Fill in bank account details - the account must be in the applicant's name and linked to Aadhaar.
Upload a passport-size photograph and submit.

For offline registration, visit the nearest Karnataka One center or attend a government-organized registration camp. Carry your ration card, Aadhaar card, bank passbook, and a passport-size photograph.
The registration staff will assist in filling the form and capturing biometric data.
After submission, the application is verified against the ration card database and income criteria. Approved beneficiaries are added to the payment list and start receiving monthly transfers.
The verification process typically takes 15 to 30 days from the date of application submission.

extra_sections.title: Documents Needed for Gruha Lakshmi Registration
extra_sections.content: Ensure you have the following ready before applying: BPL or Antyodaya ration card showing the applicant as the woman head of household, Aadhaar card of the applicant, bank account passbook (account must be in applicant's name only and Aadhaar-linked), recent passport-size photograph, and mobile number linked to Aadhaar for OTP verification. If your Aadhaar is not linked to your bank account, visit your bank branch first and complete the linking before applying.

extra_sections.heading: How to Apply Online at sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in
What is RC Number in Gruha Lakshmi? (Ration Card Number Explained)
content: The RC Number (Ration Card Number) is the most important identifier when applying for Gruha Lakshmi - it links your household to BPL/eligibility databases used by Karnataka government.
Your RC number appears on the front of your ration card, usually a 9-12 digit alphanumeric code. Without a valid RC number, your application cannot be processed.
If you lost your ration card, get a duplicate at the nearest Karnataka Food and Civil Supplies office (ahara.kar.nic.in) before applying.

extra_sections.heading: How to Check Gruha Lakshmi Status at ahara.kar.nic.in
Impact of Gruha Lakshmi Across Karnataka
content: Since its launch, Gruha Lakshmi has enrolled approximately 1 crore women across Karnataka's 31 districts. The scheme has had significant impact on women's financial inclusion, with millions of women opening their first individual bank accounts specifically to receive the benefit.

The North Karnataka districts of Kalaburagi, Raichur, Ballari, Bidar, and Yadgir - historically the most economically backward regions of the state - have seen the highest enrollment rates relative to eligible population. In these districts, the Rs 24,000 annual benefit represents a substantial supplement to household income where daily agricultural wages average Rs 200 to Rs 350.

The scheme has also increased women's engagement with the formal banking system. Women who previously had no reason to visit a bank now check their account balances, operate ATMs, and interact with banking staff regularly.
Several banks have used this opportunity to introduce micro-savings products, insurance, and other financial services to newly banked women.

extra_sections.heading: Common Problems and How to Fix Them
content:
My Ration Card is Not Linked to Aadhaar

Ration card and Aadhaar must match for the scheme to process your application. Visit your local ration shop or food and civil supplies office.
Ask them to link your Ration Card with your Aadhaar. This is free and takes a few days.
Once linked, your application will be processed.

Aadhaar Name Doesn't Match Ration Card Name

The Gruha Lakshmi scheme is very strict about name matching. If your Aadhaar says 'Radha Kumari' but your ration card says 'Radha K,' applications will get rejected.
You need to correct one of them first. Go to an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your ration card and get your name updated in Aadhaar.
This is free.

Bank Account Not Linked with Aadhaar

Without Aadhaar-linked bank account, the scheme cannot transfer money to you. Visit your bank branch with your Aadhaar and ask them to seed your account.
This is a one-time process done in minutes, and it's necessary for all DBT schemes.

My Application is Stuck or Rejected

Usually this happens because of missing documents or mismatched information. Log into the Seva Sindhu portal using your Aadhaar, check what it says about your application, and download any rejection notice.
The notice will tell you exactly what's missing. Correct it and resubmit.

extra_sections.heading: Common Problems and How to Fix Them - more
content:
Payment Not Received for Two Months

Check the Karnataka DBT app using your Aadhaar login. If it shows your payment as 'released,' the money may take 3-5 days to reach your account.
Banks process DBT transfers in batches. If it's been 7 days and money hasn't arrived, contact your bank and ask about NEFT transfers for government schemes.

Getting 'Ineligible' Message

This usually means either: (1) You earn above the income limit, (2) You're listed as a government employee, (3) Your spouse is a tax payer, or (4) Another woman from your household already gets this benefit. Verify your household's actual income and employment.
If you believe the information is wrong, file a complaint at the food and civil supplies office.

Payment failures due to Aadhaar-bank account mismatch are the most common issue. If your monthly payment is not credited, first verify at your bank branch that your Aadhaar is properly seeded with your account.

extra_sections.heading: Common Problems and How to Fix Them - more - more
content: Name mismatches between Aadhaar and bank records - even minor spelling differences - can cause payment rejection.
Ration card issues affect eligibility verification. If the woman head of household is not correctly listed on the ration card, the application will be rejected.
Visit the nearest Ration Card office or the Ahara portal to update your ration card details before applying for Gruha Lakshmi.

Application status stuck in verification for more than 30 days usually indicates a data mismatch between your ration card details and Aadhaar information. Contact the nearest Karnataka One center for assistance in resolving the discrepancy, or call the state helpline for intervention.

Some women report being turned away at registration camps because they do not have a smartphone or email address. Neither is mandatory for registration - the Gram Panchayat or Karnataka One staff should assist with the process using their own devices.
If you face this issue, escalate to the Taluka office.

extra_sections.heading: Top Gruha Lakshmi Rejection Reasons
Gruha Lakshmi vs Ladli Behna vs Majhi Ladki Bahin
content: The three major monthly women's cash transfer schemes in India offer different amounts and eligibility structures. Karnataka's Gruha Lakshmi is the most generous at Rs 2,000 per month, followed by Maharashtra's Majhi Ladki Bahin at Rs 1,500 and Madhya Pradesh's Ladli Behna at Rs 1,250.
Eligibility criteria differ significantly. Gruha Lakshmi uses the ration card to identify the woman head of household, which provides a built-in targeting mechanism.

Ladli Behna and Majhi Ladki Bahin use income-based criteria with a Rs 2.5 lakh annual family income ceiling. The ration card-based targeting of Gruha Lakshmi can be more accurate since ration card data is regularly updated and verified.

In terms of enrollment scale, all three schemes have achieved massive coverage - each enrolling 1 crore or more beneficiaries within months of launch. This demonstrates that large-scale monthly DBT to women is administratively feasible and that the demand for such schemes is immense across Indian states regardless of political alignment.

extra_sections.heading: Gruha Lakshmi vs Other State Cash Transfer Schemes

extra_sections.text: At Rs 2,000 per month, Gruha Lakshmi recognizes what every household already knows - the woman who manages the home is the true economic backbone of the family, and she deserves financial support in her own name.

extra_sections.heading: Financial Planning Tips for Gruha Lakshmi Beneficiaries
content: With Rs 2,000 per month - the highest among comparable state schemes - Gruha Lakshmi beneficiaries have meaningful room for both consumption and savings. Here are practical strategies for making the most of this benefit.

Allocating Rs 500 per month to a Post Office Recurring Deposit at current interest rates builds approximately Rs 6,300 after one year. Over 5 years, this grows to around Rs 34,000 - a safety net for medical emergencies or seasonal income disruptions.
The remaining Rs 1,500 can cover daily household expenses, children's educational materials, or healthcare costs.

For women with entrepreneurial aspirations, saving 3 to 4 months of the full Rs 2,000 creates seed capital of Rs 6,000 to Rs 8,000. Common micro-enterprises that can be started with this amount in Karnataka include tailoring, flower garland making, dairy products, snack production, and vegetable vending.
Karnataka's Stree Shakti self-help group network provides additional training, mentorship, and group lending support for women starting small businesses.

Opening a Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana account for daughters using a portion of the Gruha Lakshmi benefit can create a substantial education or marriage fund. Even Rs 500 per month deposited consistently yields approximately Rs 1.9 lakh over 15 years at current SSY interest rates - enough to fund higher education at a state college.

extra_sections.title: Gruha Lakshmi Biometric Enrollment at Bapuji Seva Kendra
extra_sections.content:
After online registration, visit nearest Bapuji Seva Kendra within 30 days for biometric verification. Carry Aadhaar, ration card, bank passbook.

Without biometric, application stays pending.

extra_sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Gruha Lakshmi
content: Can unmarried women apply? Yes, if an unmarried woman is listed as the head of household on her BPL or AAY ration card, she is eligible.
The scheme does not require the applicant to be married - it targets the woman head of household regardless of marital status.
What if my ration card shows a male member as the head? You will need to update your ration card to list the eligible woman as the head of household.
Visit the nearest Ration Card office or use the Ahara portal to request this change. The Gruha Lakshmi benefit can only be issued to the woman listed as head on the ration card.
Will the monthly amount increase? The Karnataka government has indicated willingness to increase the amount based on fiscal capacity.

extra_sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Gruha Lakshmi - more
content: However, no official timeline for an increase has been announced. The current Rs 2,000 per month has been the amount since the scheme's launch.

Can I receive Gruha Lakshmi along with other government benefits? Yes, the scheme is compatible with most other welfare schemes including food subsidies, housing scheme benefits, and education scholarships.
The only exclusion is for women already receiving government pension above a specified threshold.
Is the Rs 2,000 monthly amount taxable? No, this welfare benefit from the state government is not considered taxable income and does not need to be reported in income tax returns.
What if I move to another state? Gruha Lakshmi requires Karnataka residency with a valid Karnataka ration card.
If you permanently relocate to another state and surrender your Karnataka ration card, your eligibility for the scheme would end. Temporary travel does not affect enrollment.

extra_sections.heading: Gruha Lakshmi Application Timeline
How Gruha Lakshmi Is Funded
content: Gruha Lakshmi is funded from the Karnataka state budget as part of the five guarantee schemes announced by the state government. The annual fiscal outlay for the scheme exceeds Rs 24,000 crore given the enrollment of approximately 1 crore women at Rs 24,000 per year each.

The scheme's fiscal impact has been a topic of public debate, with economists discussing the balance between direct benefit transfer spending and capital expenditure on infrastructure and development. Proponents argue that the money goes directly into the hands of women who spend it in the local economy, generating a multiplier effect that supports small businesses, agriculture markets, and essential services.

The Karnataka government has maintained that the five guarantee schemes are fiscally sustainable within the state's revenue capacity, funded through a combination of existing budget reallocations, improved tax collection, and leveraging of the state's strong economic base as one of India's highest GDP states.

extra_sections.title: Helpline and Support Contacts
extra_sections.content:
For Gruha Lakshmi related queries, contact the Seva Sindhu helpline or visit sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in. For ration card updates, use the Ahara portal at ahara.kar.nic.in or visit your nearest Ration Card office.

For bank account and Aadhaar linking issues, contact your bank's customer care with your Aadhaar number. For unresolved grievances, file a complaint on the Karnataka Chief Minister's grievance portal or contact the District Women and Child Development Officer.

extra_sections.heading: Renewal and Continued Eligibility
content: Gruha Lakshmi does not require annual renewal from beneficiaries. Once your application is approved, monthly payments continue automatically as long as your eligibility criteria remain unchanged.
The state government conducts periodic verification drives using ration card databases and income records to confirm that beneficiaries still meet the criteria.

If your ration card status changes - for example, if your household moves from BPL to APL category during re-survey - your eligibility will be reviewed. Beneficiaries who are dropped due to data updates can appeal at the nearest Karnataka One center with supporting documentation proving their continued eligibility.

Women who become government employees or whose family members become income tax payers after enrollment are expected to voluntarily inform the authorities and withdraw from the scheme. During verification drives, such cases are identified through cross-referencing with government employee and income tax databases, and benefits are discontinued with a notice.

extra_sections.heading: Using Gruha Lakshmi for Children's Education
content: Education expenses are one of the primary uses of Gruha Lakshmi benefits reported by beneficiaries across Karnataka. Even modest monthly investments in children's education create compounding returns over years that far exceed the investment amount.

Rs 500 per month directed toward school-related expenses covers textbooks, notebooks, school uniforms, and basic stationery for one child in a government school. For families with children in private schools, the Rs 2,000 monthly benefit can partially offset tuition fees that typically range from Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 per month in Karnataka's smaller cities and towns.
For children approaching Class 10 and Class 12 board exams, the benefit can fund coaching or tuition classes that improve academic outcomes and expand future career options.

how_to_apply.title: Visit the Seva Sindhu Portal
how_to_apply.description: Go to sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in on your computer or mobile phone. This is the official government portal for all Karnataka welfare schemes.

how_to_apply.title: Register or Log In
how_to_apply.description: If you're a first-time user, click 'New Registration.' Enter your Aadhaar number and mobile number linked to your Aadhaar. You'll receive an OTP. Enter it to verify. If you've registered before, just log in with your credentials.

how_to_apply.title: Select Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
how_to_apply.description: On the dashboard, search for 'Gruha Lakshmi' in the scheme list. Click on it to open the application form.

how_to_apply.title: Fill in Your Details
how_to_apply.description: Enter your personal information: full name (as it appears in Aadhaar), ration card number, card type (Antyodaya/BPL/APL), bank account number, IFSC code, and spouse's details if married. Double-check everything - any mismatch will cause rejection.

how_to_apply.title: Upload Documents
how_to_apply.description: Upload clear photos or scans of: Aadhaar card, ration card, bank passbook, and address proof. Ensure all images are clear and readable. The portal may reject blurry documents.

how_to_apply.title: Submit and Print Acknowledgment
how_to_apply.description: Review all details once more, then click 'Submit.' The portal will give you an acknowledgment number. Print this page or save the PDF. Keep it safe - you'll need it if there are questions about your application.

how_to_apply.title: Wait for Verification
how_to_apply.description: The food and civil supplies office will verify your documents and eligibility details. This takes 10-15 days. You can track the status anytime on the Seva Sindhu portal using your acknowledgment number.

how_to_apply.title: Receive Your First Payment
how_to_apply.description: Once approved, you'll receive an SMS confirming eligibility. Your first ₹2,000 will be transferred to your bank account within 30 days. After that, payments come every month automatically.

important_alert.text: Aadhaar Seeding is Mandatory: Your bank account MUST be linked with your Aadhaar number for payments to reach you. Without this link, the DBT system cannot process your monthly transfer. Visit your bank if you haven't linked your account yet - it's free and takes just a few minutes.

important_dates.label: Benefit Duration
important_dates.value: Ongoing (as long as you meet eligibility criteria)

faqs.question: What is ahara.kar.nic.in and how is it related to Gruha Lakshmi?
faqs.answer:
ahara.kar.nic.in is the official Karnataka government portal for the Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs department - it manages ration card data and beneficiary databases. It is one of the primary portals used for Gruha Lakshmi registration since eligibility is partly based on ration card records.

Visit ahara.kar.nic.in to check your Karnataka ration card status, which is linked to your Gruha Lakshmi eligibility. The Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in) is the other official application channel.

faqs.question: How to apply for Gruha Lakshmi scheme online in Karnataka?
faqs.answer:
To apply for Gruha Lakshmi online in Karnataka: (1) Visit ahara.kar.nic.in or sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in. (2) Search for 'Gruha Lakshmi' scheme.

(3) Login or register with your mobile number. (4) Fill the application with Aadhaar number, ration card details, and bank account (linked to Aadhaar).

(5) Upload required documents - Aadhaar card, ration card, bank passbook. (6) Submit and note your application reference number.

You can also apply offline at Karnataka One centres or your nearest Gram Panchayat/Ward office. Eligibility: woman who is the head of household with an active Karnataka ration card.

faqs.question: Can I apply if I'm divorced or separated?
faqs.answer:
Yes. If you're the head of your household after divorce or separation, you're eligible.

Make sure your ration card lists you as the head and you meet the income criteria.

faqs.question: What if my husband is alive but doesn't work?
faqs.answer:
That's fine. The scheme only checks if your spouse is a government employee or income tax payer.

If he's unemployed or does informal work without filing taxes, it doesn't affect your eligibility. You still need to show your combined household income is below the limit.

faqs.question: Do I need to renew my application every year?
faqs.answer:
No. Once approved, the benefit continues automatically as long as your ration card remains valid and you meet the eligibility criteria.

You'll keep receiving ₹2,000 every month unless there's a major change - like getting a government job or becoming a tax payer.

faqs.question: Can my daughter apply if she's also head of a household?
faqs.answer:
No. The scheme gives only one benefit per household.

If you're already receiving Gruha Lakshmi as the head of your household, no one else from your family can get it. Your daughter would need to establish her own separate household with her own ration card.

faqs.question: What if my Aadhaar and ration card have different names?
faqs.answer:
They must match exactly for the application to go through. Go to an Aadhaar Enrollment Center with your ration card and update your Aadhaar to match.

This is free and takes a few days. Then resubmit your application.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get the first payment after approval?
faqs.answer:
Usually 30 days from the date your application is approved. The system adds you to the next monthly transfer batch.

You'll get an SMS notification when the first ₹2,000 is released. Then check the DBT app to confirm it hit your account.

faqs.question: Can someone help me apply if I can't use a computer?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Visit your nearest food and civil supplies office or ration shop.

Staff there can help you fill out the application on the Seva Sindhu portal for free. Many villages also have Common Service Centers (CSCs) that help with government applications - they might charge a small fee.

faqs.question: What if I moved to another state after getting approved?
faqs.answer:
The Gruha Lakshmi benefit stops if you move away from Karnataka. The scheme is specific to Karnataka residents.

If you move back to Karnataka, you can reapply if you still meet the eligibility criteria.

faqs.question: Can working women apply for Gruha Lakshmi?
faqs.answer:
Yes, if they are the head of household on the ration card and meet the income criteria. However, women who are government employees or whose family pays income tax are excluded.

Self-employed women, daily wage workers, and women in the unorganized sector are eligible as long as they hold BPL/Antyodaya ration cards.

faqs.question: What is RC number in Gruha Lakshmi scheme?
faqs.answer: RC Number is your Ration Card Number - a 9-12 digit alphanumeric code on the front of your Karnataka ration card. Primary identifier used by Sevasindhu portal to verify household eligibility.

faqs.question: How to check Gruha Lakshmi status at ahara.kar.nic.in?
faqs.answer: Visit ahara.kar.nic.in or sevasindhu.gov.in, navigate to 'Gruha Lakshmi Status', enter RC number and captcha. Shows status, last payment date, pending issues.

faqs.question: Is Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi same as Telangana Gruha Lakshmi?
faqs.answer:
No, different. Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi gives ₹2,000 monthly cash transfer.

Telangana Gruha Lakshmi was a BRS-era housing scheme replaced by Indiramma Indlu.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for Gruha Lakshmi in 2026?
faqs.answer: No fixed annual deadline - open round the year on Sevasindhu portal. Applications by 15th of any month get processed for next month's payment.
